p: was a child: While the Israelites were in Egypt, and did not provoke my wrath by their malice and ingratitude.
went from them: They rebelled and went a contrary way when the Prophets called them to repentance.
of a man: That is, friendly, and not as beasts or slaves.
king: Seeing that they condemn all this kindness, they will be led captive into Assyria.
they called them to the most: That is, the Prophets.
How shall I give thee up: God considers with himself, and that with a certain grief, how to punish them.
Admah: Which were two of the cities that were destroyed with Sodom; De 29:23.

my repentings are kindled together: Meaning that his love with which he first loved them positioned him between doubt and assurance in terms of what to do: and in this appears his Fatherly affection, that his mercy toward his own will overcome his judgments, as he declares in the next verse.
enter into the city: To consume you, but will cause you to yield, and so have mercy on you: and this is meant of the final number who will walk after the Lord.
They shall tremble as a bird: The Egyptians and the Assyrians will be afraid when the Lord maintains his people.
God: Governs their state according to God's word, and does not degenerate.
